title: The Viscosity of Logic: Phase Transitions and Hysteresis in DPO Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on the dynamics of DPO alignment and its effect on logical reasoning and other capabilities. While it includes 'sycophancy' as a probe, it defines it as 'resistance to false claims'—a measure of factual/logical integrity—rather than benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as defined in the instructions.
